prompt:
Create a vertical minimalist Zen poster composed of exactly 2 stacked panels. Top panel: a photorealistic, cinematic landscape occupying the upper half, showing exactly 1 solitary monk-like figure seen from behind, seated cross-legged on a small rectangular bamboo raft in the center of a still dark teal lake. The figure wears a deep indigo blue robe and a pale straw conical hat; the body and hat are reflected softly in the water. The background is a dense, dark green forest across the lake with one pale vertical limestone cliff rising near the upper center-left, softly out of focus. Use calm water, muted blue-green tones, quiet atmosphere, shallow depth of field, and large negative space around the figure. Bottom panel: an off-white handmade paper field occupying the lower half, like a minimal art-book layout. Near the lower center, render exactly 1 black stippled ink illustration of the same seated figure on the raft, including its vertical water reflection, using halftone dots and sparse horizontal ink strokes. In the upper-right area of the bottom panel, place exactly 1 small vertical text block reading stillness
is
a
return. in tiny gray serif type, with each word on its own line, and exactly 1 solid black circular dot below-left of the text block. Overall style: Chinese Zen aesthetic, wabi-sabi minimalism, editorial poster design, balanced asymmetry, serene silence, high contrast between photographic top and ink-print bottom. Canvas ratio 3:4, no border, no watermark, no extra figures, no extra text.

promptZh:
创作一张方形极简主义禅意双联画海报，包含两个上下堆叠的面板。上半部分是一张写实的电影质感摄影作品，画面中一位僧人或冥想者背对镜头，盘腿坐在深青色静谧湖中央的一叶小竹筏上，身穿深海军蓝长袍，头戴浅色斗笠。湖面平静，泛着柔和的涟漪，人物倒影隐约可见；远景是模糊的茂密森林，上方中心附近隐约可见一座浅色石灰岩悬崖。采用忧郁的蓝绿色调、静谧的自然光、浅景深，并在微小的主体周围留出大面积的负空间。下半部分是一块带有纹理的米白色纸质艺术面板，将同一场景转化为稀疏的黑色点画插图：同样的盘坐人物和斗笠位于下方中心，坐在一条细长的竹筏线条上，下方有圆点组成的倒影。在右侧添加一个黑色小圆圈，并在右上角附近添加一首微小的竖排诗句，内容必须完全为“stillness
is
a
return.”。保持构图宁静、平衡且极简，严格包含两个面板，每个面板重复出现一个中心人物和一个竹筏，下方面板包含一个黑色圆圈，且无任何多余文字或水印。主体应唤起 中国禅意静谧 的氛围，并使用 深海军蓝 的长袍，深青色 的湖水，stillness
is
a
return. 的诗句，以及 暖米白色 的纸张色调。
